newsitem.title: USA: ACNielsen says court partly dismiss IRI suit.
newsitem.headline: ACNielsen says court partly dismiss IRI suit.

text.p: ACNielsen Corp said a federal court had dismissed a key portion of a lawsuit Information Resources Inc had brought against ACNielsen alleging anti-competitive practices.

In a procedural ruling, Judge Louis Stanton of the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York threw out Information Resources claim of attempted monopolization of the U.S. market, ACNielsen said.
Information Resources Inc would have the chance to prove its remaining claims in court, ACNielsen said.
Information Resources was not immediately available to comment.
In allowing Information Resources to plead certain of its claims again, ACNielsen said the judge did not address the merits of the claims or make any determination of facts.
In December, ACNielsen said the Antitrust Division of the U.S. Department of Justice terminated its inquiry into whether the company engaged in possible anticompetitive practices.
